title: Shaky Gotcha - Rotating Gacha Capsule Cylinder

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: A capsule-toy (gachapon) machine: rotate the cylindrical drum until a capsule drops into the chute; a DJ/arcade cabinet frames the play session with sound.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: A mobile-first 3D web arcade: rotating the cylinder browses/draws gacha items, tapping 'Shakys' collects them, and a triggerable 'Rage Mode' alters game state; a DJ console packs 22 tracks as diegetic sound design. The 3D gallery doubles as the prize shelf.

design_tokens.borders: Toy-molded capsule and cabinet silhouettes; chunky arcade bezels
design_tokens.elevation: Real 3D drum rotation; UI chrome flat and arcade-styled
design_tokens.typography: Arcade poster display type; character names as collectible labels

interactive_mechanics: Rotate the 3D capsule drum to browse and draw
Tap characters to collect; Rage Mode as a state-shifting power-up
DJ console with 22 tracks as interactive diegetic audio
3D gallery acts as the collected-prizes shelf
usability_notes: Gacha/drum rotation gives browsing a tactile 'one draw per spin' pacing that fits collectibles and merch drops. Mobile-first 3D is demanding: keep poly counts low, gate Rage Mode audio, and ensure the collect action never depends on 3D precision. Source: Awwwards nominee summary (solo-developed 3D web arcade); live-site verification pending.
